title: The Flawless Facet Canon
summary: A canon of the facet cut without a flaw so that force and light pass through it with no loss and no scatter.

title: Treatise of the Diamond Edge
summary: A treatise on the edge of crystal qi hardened until nothing in reach can resist it and ending in a single perfect cut.

title: Mastery of the Refracted Lance
summary: A mastery of bending a lance of qi through crystal until it strikes from angles the target cannot guard.

title: The Crystal Spire Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of tall crystal spires raised from the qi field that lift the user and impale the foe.

title: Canon of the Cold Cleavage
summary: A canon of the cold clean cleavage that splits a guard along its weakest plane with a single stroke.

title: Treatise of the Hexagonal Ward
summary: A treatise on the six-sided ward of crystal qi that shares its load among its faces and locks the foe inside.

title: Manual of the Grown Cluster
summary: A manual of crystal that grows in clusters from a single seed of qi to bind the foe and heal the friend.

title: The Symmetry Perfected Treatise
summary: A treatise on the perfect symmetry of strike and guard that returns every force exactly as it came.
